scope: Rounding/UV renderer optimization; exact retained arithmetic and native-output regression, plus scoped live CPU observations. Full game and original scene fidelity remain incomplete.

original_arithmetic.source: worker report above; native reruns against retained original fixtures

limitations: Both recordings exclude waiting threads; GPU execution, blocked time, presentation cadence and audio underruns are not quantified.
Full-recording normalization divides sample weights by exported recording duration; common interior uses [1,20) relative trace seconds (19 seconds). Neither is per-game-frame normalization.
Inclusive metrics overlap. Self samples may include optimized/inlined code. Three optimized running samples have no backtrace and remain in total/main denominators.
Baseline has named IOThread/AQConverterThread samples and AudioOutput callback samples; optimized has none. Music synthesis is sampled in both. Device-audio workload equivalence is not established.

Single recordings, different processes/times, no repetition or statistical confidence interval. Inputs/checkpoint/recording options were reported equivalent; exact game-frame windows were not recorded.
Native diagnostic traces and PCM recording remained enabled. Changes in sampled stage weights do not alone isolate an optimization causal effect.
Native regression retains prior behavior, including known original timing, lighting, raster and audio discrepancies.
The six selected images are sparse complete frames, not every frame of the replay.
Arithmetic corpus validates recovered functions; it is not a full-scene PS2 raster comparison.
No FPS, GPU duration, presentation cadence, audio underrun, listening or full-playthrough claim.
Optimized audio threads were registered but contributed no running samples; absence of samples does not demonstrate disabled audio.
